The portfolio also includes synthesis and self-assessment.

requirements.title: Quantitative and perspectives credit policies
requirements.summary: Quantitative reasoning requires a passing letter grade in an approved course of at least three credits; approved test and transfer credit may satisfy it. Moral/ethical reasoning, global perspectives, and human diversity each require passing letter grades in an approved course or sequence. Local/global engagement permits passing an approved course/sequence or participating in an approved activity. Transfer substitution for any perspective requires FSCUE appeal approval.

requirements.title: Secondary-major relationship
requirements.summary: This record represents the full AI degree. Students completing AI only as a secondary major within another undergraduate degree are exempt from this AI degree's school-specific requirements under the published program policy.

requirements.title: AI-related substitutions
requirements.summary: AI-related unlisted courses may satisfy specific requirements with prior academic-advisor permission. For technical electives, prior permission must instead come from the department chair or designee. The Group 2 any-CSDS rule remains an open eligible pool, limited to two of four electives; no double counting. Suggested two-course probability/statistics or numerical-methods/optimization sequences are recommendations, not extra required courses.

requirements.title: Conditional requisite and career permission
requirements.summary: Course prerequisites, corequisites and other enrollment conditions remain binding unless Requisites Not Met permission is granted. Cross-career restrictions can additionally require approval from the student’s or course’s school registrar/dean. Listed graduate-program-restricted electives such as SCMG 462/463 are conditional options requiring the relevant permissions if the student does not meet their published conditions. Listing is not guaranteed enrollment or blanket waiver; after approval the student must still register.

requirements.title: Career permission requires administrator action
requirements.summary: Career-restricted enrollment requests require action by the appropriate school registrar or administrator in addition to any instructor action. Permission can be granted or denied; approval does not itself enroll the student.
